description: Header file for STM32F7 series microcontroller's FLASH hardware abstraction layer (HAL), defining types, constants, macros, and function prototypes for flash memory operations.

classes.name: FLASH_ProcessTypeDef
classes.description: Structure representing the current state and parameters of a flash operation.

classes.name: FLASH_ProcedureTypeDef
classes.description: Enumeration of flash procedures: none, sector erase, mass erase, program.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_Program
methods.description: Function to program flash memory with specified data.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_Program_IT
methods.description: Function to program flash memory with interrupt.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_EndOfOperationCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked at end of flash operation.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_OperationErrorCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked on flash operation error.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_GetError
methods.description: Returns the last flash error code.

methods.name: FLASH_WaitForLastOperation
methods.description: Waits for the last flash operation to complete.
